hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory

baseline_tuning.selection: Progressively reduce chunks if memory budget or latency requires it; evaluate unquantized fused attention where it fits. Low-bit cache requires a separate quality check.

budget_note: Recommended GPU working set, not physical memory limit and not simulated smaller hardware. An allocation-budget stop is not OOM.
user_preference: Long documents / code analysis; willing to wait several minutes for initial processing, wants fluent subsequent generation.
evidence_rule: A larger-model capacity claim requires the larger model to meet the same memory, latency and quality criteria only after the change, versus reasonably tuned baseline configurations. If a tuned baseline also passes, report speed/headroom improvement instead.
screening: One fresh-process trial after 512-token warmup. Repeat decisive comparisons; screening results alone are not final timing claims.
system_metrics: Record system-wide swap and pressure before load, after load, throughout prefill and after generation. Existing background swap is not a benchmark failure; no causal swap claim from unpaired trials.
early_stop_policy: Stop a target prefill after a chunk exceeds 300 seconds, since it has already failed the predeclared latency limit. Report a lower bound, not a completed TTFT. Memory-budget and system-pressure stops remain distinct from OOM.
